interpretation: One-step accurate frozen DMO Gaussian component does not supply a competent closed-loop gradient MPC in this fixed configuration. No attacked agent or safety effect was measured. Do not use its failure as attack evidence or expand this weak baseline.
compatibility_fix: Restored upstream fixed max_logvar=.5 and min_logvar=-10 only when absent from GPU checkpoint; all learned parameters loaded strictly.

carrier_checks.name: MBDPO
carrier_checks.finding: Latent transition is deterministic; native diffusion planner is explicitly gradient-free and decorated no_grad. Unsuitable for the proposed sampler-gradient operation.

carrier_checks.name: GRASP
carrier_checks.finding: Stochasticity described in inspected paper concerns state iterates of the optimizer; that is not evidence of a stochastic transition sampler.

carrier_checks.name: ITPO
carrier_checks.finding: Paper has differentiable stochastic diffusion rollouts and pretrained offline policies; no callable public repository or checkpoint located in this search. This is an availability observation, not proof that none exists.

mathematical_constraints.name: Fixed Gaussian sampler cannot support this exact weights-only attack
mathematical_constraints.statement: On an open input domain, equality of nonsingular diagonal Gaussian laws forces equality of mean and positive standard deviation functions. Wherever differentiable, their Jacobians agree; a fixed mu(x)+sigma(x)*epsilon sampler therefore has identical pathwise derivatives at the same epsilon.
mathematical_constraints.scope: Exact conditional law equality over all inputs; does not rule out approximate fidelity attacks, finite test-set matching, or different sampler architectures.

mathematical_constraints.name: Forward-only adaptive planners are invariant to whole conditional oracle-law preservation
mathematical_constraints.statement: If every forecast response has the same conditional joint law given the entire prior query-response transcript, an adaptive planner observing only forward responses has the same action distribution by induction. Independent law-preserving noise reparameterizations meet this condition.
mathematical_constraints.scope: Does not apply to the old rank-coupling operation, which preserves individual candidate marginals but changes their joint response law. Gradients are extra observations and need not be preserved.
